brief.candidateLattice: x and y in 0..40 step 2 (441 integer candidates)
brief.boundaryRule: a candidate belongs to the stratum whose closed rectangle contains it
brief.algorithm: seeded Fisher-Yates with LCG(state*1103515245+12345 mod 2**31), then a greedy accept per stratum under squared distance >= 25
